text: Gold rose about 0.8% to near $3,906 overnight as bargain hunters returned after Friday's drop to a one-year low.
Silver gained about 2.2% to $50.22, back above $50, pulling the gold/silver ratio down to about 78 from 79.4.
Gold miners and silver funds pointed higher before the open: GDX up about 1.7%, GDXJ 1.9% and SLV 1.6% in early pre-market trading.
Brent fell about 3% to near $110 a barrel as Iran and Qatar held a third day of talks on ending the war, easing inflation worries.
Stock futures rose after last week's AI-driven selloff, with Nasdaq-100 futures up about 0.8% and S&P 500 futures up about 0.5%; Apple reports after the close.
Treasury yields were mixed: the 10-year eased to about 4.91% while the 2-year held near 4.60%.
